title: With all eye on delimitation & FCRA, Parliament monsoon session sinks deeper into deadlock
content: Parliament has hit yet another impasse as the opposition protests continue for the thirteenth day. Despite this, the government succeeded in passing important legislation, including the Bankers' Books Evidence Bill and a bill concerning Supreme Court judges. In an effort to resolve the deadlock, minister Kiren Rijiju met with opposition figures, while Prime Minister Modi focused on discussing strategies with BJP Members of Parliament.

title: Black Sea attack: Merchant Navy officer's family refuses cremation, seeks martyr status
content: Following a brutal attack in the Black Sea, the remains of Merchant Navy chief officer Sagar Gupta were brought back to Kanpur. His family, deeply affected by the loss, has declared they will not conduct any last rites until specific demands are fulfilled, including martyr recognition, financial compensation, and employment for his widow.

title: 'I worked tirelessly while staying in Pakistan': Nadeem blames cold for CWG poor show
content: Pakistan’s Olympic javelin champion Arshad Nadeem blamed Glasgow’s cold weather for his ninth-place Commonwealth Games finish, saying it stiffened his body and affected his run-up. Despite the setback, he urged fans not to lose faith and promised a strong comeback. Nadeem’s next challenge is the Lausanne Diamond League on August 21, where he will face Neeraj Chopra.

title: OpenAI's Greg Brockman gives millions to save eagles Jackie and Shadow's home
content: Greg Brockman and his wife Anna donated five point five million dollars to save shoreline forest.  This significant contribution helped secure ten million dollars for land conservation efforts.  The land, which is home to rare species, will now be protected from development.  Over twenty-five thousand small donors also contributed to the successful fundraising campaign.  Meanwhile, the eagle matriarch Jackie faces an uncertain health prognosis.

title: Cong vs Cong in Punjab: With 'sleeper cell' warning, party puts Channi camp on notice
content: Amid rising infighting, the Congress party has issued a stern warning to Punjab's dissenters regarding their involvement with internal 'sleeper cells.' Amarinder Singh Raja Warring, the state president, has promised that party members acting against Congress will face consequences, with no tickets granted to them. The situation intensifies as Charanjit Singh Channi's supporters openly question the leadership, complicating the party's position in the face of a multi-dimensional electoral challenge in assembly elections early next year.

title: Indian-American Congressman Shri Thanedar loses Democratic primary in Michigan
content: Shri Thanedar lost the Michigan Democratic primary to Donavan McKinney. McKinney secured victory with support from the party's progressive wing. Thanedar acknowledged the socialist movement's influence on the election outcome. His defeat may reduce Indian-American representation in the House. Thanedar expressed gratitude for his service and plans to remain active.

title: Why US cities are deactivating Flock Safety cameras and canceling contracts
content: Cities across America are deactivating Flock's automated license plate reader cameras. Residents are damaging these devices amid widespread privacy concerns and data collection fears. Reports of law enforcement misuse have further fueled opposition to the surveillance technology. Flock maintains its cameras balance public safety and individual privacy rights. The company has implemented new audit processes to monitor technology usage.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
content: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: Suspected sulphur dioxide leak kills 3 factory workers in Karnataka's Yadgir
content: A catastrophic event unfolded in Yadgir district early Wednesday as a suspected sulphur dioxide leak claimed the lives of three workers and left two others injured. Reports suggest that the chemical leak caused suffocation among the employees present. The victims were migrant laborers hailing from Telangana and Madhya Pradesh, and the survivors are now under medical care at a nearby hospital.

title: How Cristiano Ronaldo overcame poverty and loss to become a football legend
content: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey is about much more than football. From growing up in poverty and leaving home at 12 to losing his father before achieving global success, every challenge shaped the player he became. His story reminds people that discipline, sacrifice and love for family can help overcome even the hardest moments and turn dreams into reality.

title: How Travis Kelce is transforming lives beyond football in Kansas City
content: Kansas City Chiefs star Travis Kelce supports local children and families. He partnered with Kodiak to provide twenty-five thousand hot meals. Kelce also invested in Operation Breakthrough, a Kansas City nonprofit. His Eighty-Seven & Running Foundation supports youth programs and career exploration. This initiative offers practical skills and a safe space for students.

title: Meet Brock Lesnar's family: Wife Sable, children, parents and siblings
content: Brock Lesnar, the WWE legend, leads a private family life with his wife Sable.  They share two sons, Turk and Duke, who play competitive hockey.  Lesnar also has twins, Mya and Luke, from a previous relationship.  Mya excels in college shot put while Luke wrestles competitively.  Raised on a South Dakota dairy farm, Lesnar credits his parents for his strong work ethic.

title: R Madhavan says he has no political ambitions, calls CM Vijay a dear friend
content: Actor R Madhavan shared his joy for his friend Vijay, now in the Chief Minister's role, while firmly stating that he has no ambitions in politics. He described politics as a complicated affair and expressed no desire to take on such responsibilities. Additionally, Madhavan talked about his role in 'GDN,' where he will portray inventor G. D.

title: Rupee hits 1-month closing high despite RBI pause; sliding oil prices help
content: The currency opened 0.5% stronger at 94.92 against the US dollar, its highest level since July 1. It later gave up nearly half of its early advance to settle at 95.1175 per dollar, its strongest closing level since July 7.

title: Lock Upp 2 Grand Finale: Shreya Kalra wins by 7 votes, bags Rs 1 crore
content: Shreya Kalra has triumphed in the electrifying finale of Lock Upp 2, being crowned the champion along with a lucrative cash prize of one crore rupees. Shivangi Joshi finished as the first runner-up in a nail-biting race where only seven votes distinguished the two finalists. As the news broke, fans expressed a spectrum of emotions, praising Kalra's accomplishment while showing admiration for Joshi's remarkable journey in the competition.

title: ‘Who brought 12-yr-old to protest site?’: POCSO action sought against CJP’s Dipke, Das
content: Advocate Rinki Chatterjee Singh filed a complaint seeking a Zero FIR against CJP leaders.  She questioned the presence of a 12-year-old child at a recent protest.  The advocate alleged organizers involved minors in the demonstration against the NEET paper leak.  Singh also raised concerns about the funding sources for the CJP protests.  Her complaint seeks action under the POCSO Act and Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

title: India's clean-energy challenge is no longer generation, but adoption: Experts
content: India has built significant renewable energy capacity and now needs integration. Experts highlight transmission and storage as key hurdles for clean energy use. The nation requires substantial energy storage capacity by 2030 for grid stability. Implementation and adoption of clean energy technologies are now the priority. Better policy, finance, and technology alignment will advance India's clean energy transition.

title: 'No ambulances, no coordination': Family alleges lapses after Air India turbulence scare
content: Palak Raniwala, daughter of the passenger injured on the Air India flight AI2379 operating from Phuket to Delhi after it faced sudden loss of altitude during cruise, recounted the harrowing experience, saying that the turbulence was so severe that it caused passengers, including her father, to touch the ceiling of the aircraft.

title: 'I wasted my best years': Ankur Warikoo's advice to a 35-year-old
content: Entrepreneur and content creator Ankur Warikoo has sparked a conversation on resilience after sharing his response to a 35-year-old professional facing a career setback. Through practical advice on taking responsibility, learning consistently and focusing on small, actionable steps, Warikoo underscores that rebuilding a meaningful life begins with changing one's mindset, not dwelling on past mistakes.

title: 'Don't use students for politics': BJP attacks Rahul over Jantar Mantar protest claims
content: The Bharatiya Janata Party has rejected Rahul Gandhi's allegations of police excesses.  BJP spokesperson Sambit Patra stated no bullets were fired during the protest.  He accused Gandhi of spreading a false narrative and using students politically.  Patra also questioned Gandhi's selective focus on certain student groups.  The party maintained that ministers attend Parliament when their departments are discussed.

title: RBI holds repo rate: Housing market eyes stronger festive housing demand
content: The Reserve Bank of India has maintained its benchmark repo rate at 5.25 percent, a move likely to foster buyer confidence and stimulate housing demand. Experts believe this steady rate will promote home purchases and encourage investments in real estate. The construction sector and related industries are expected to thrive with predictable borrowing costs, especially during the festive season.

title: Who is Tewolde Gebremariam? All you need to know about Air India’s new CEO
content: Tewolde Gebremariam takes over from Campbell Wilson, the New Zealander and former Singapore Airlines executive who was appointed in 2022 to lead Air India's transformation. Air India had earlier disclosed that Wilson had informed Chairman N Chandrasekaran in 2024 of his intention to step down during 2026.

title: After Pakistan boxer, Uganda athletes go ‘missing’ in Glasgow after CWG
content: Scottish police are probing reports of athletes from Pakistan and Uganda going missing after the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. Four Ugandan boxers reportedly disappeared, with one seeking asylum, while Pakistani boxer Qudratullah was also reported missing. Pakistan finished with just one medal, a bronze for Fatima Zahra, marking its poorest Commonwealth Games campaign in decades.

title: Nearly 2,000 RSS volunteers assist over 40,000 flood-affected families in Assam
content: Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh volunteers aided over forty thousand families in Assam's flood-hit regions. They provided rescue, food, and essential supplies to affected villagers in three districts. Medical camps were organized by the organization in collaboration with the National Medicos Organization. Volunteers also assisted with post-flood rehabilitation, including cleaning and agricultural support. These efforts focused on helping communities recover after the recent devastating floods.

title: Brock Lesnar retires: WWE legend shares official statement and future plans
content: Brock Lesnar has hung up his wrestling boots after a climactic showdown at SummerSlam 2026, where he was defeated by Oba Femi in the main event. In a reflective interview afterward, he revealed his intention to focus on family life and pursue recreational hunting. Lesnar showed immense appreciation for his fans, acknowledging their integral role in his journey through the wrestling world.

title: Delhi cop loses Rs 6 lakh in gaming, scripts ATM thefts to recover losses
content: After incurring heavy losses in online gaming, a Delhi Police constable turned to ATM theft as a solution. He gathered a team and taught them criminal tactics through internet videos. Their efforts led to the theft of more than twelve lakh rupees from two ATMs in Faridabad. However, the constable was left empty-handed when his gang refused to share the loot.

title: 'When Dhoni stepped away, Kohli-Shastri toughened Indian cricket': Rahane
content: Ajinkya Rahane believes Virat Kohli and Ravi Shastri toughened Indian cricket.  They instilled a fearless and aggressive approach, especially in overseas matches.  India achieved significant success under their leadership during this period.  Rahane expressed concern about the current Test cricket mentality and resilience.  He noted a decline in the patience required for difficult match phases.

title: Sambhal violence 2024: Probe panel claims unrest 'pre-planned', links SP MP, MLA
content: Last year, three-member panel had met the CM and submitted its report concerning the violence that erupted near the Shahi Jama Masjid on November 24 in 2024 during an ASI-monitored survey of the mosque. The unrest resulted in four fatalities and injuries to several others. In the document, a sharp demographic shift is observed.

title: Morgan Freeman's quote on taking a leap of faith to chase your dreams
content: Morgan Freeman's career is defined by dignity and wisdom.  His quote emphasizes risking everything for unseen dreams.  Freeman aspired to be a fighter pilot in his youth.  He later pursued acting, debuting on Broadway in 1967.  His extensive filmography includes numerous acclaimed performances.

title: Food for thought: Is Delhi's midday meal nutritious enough?
content: A dead lizard in a Delhi school lunch has renewed scrutiny of the midday meal program.  Concerns include hygiene, serving portions, and menu variety for students.  The PM Poshan scheme outlines nutritional entitlements for primary and upper primary students.  Budget limitations influence menu planning, affecting the inclusion of items like eggs.  Teachers and parents debate whether the promised nutrition reaches every child's plate.

title: Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway damage: Toll collection suspended
content: The National Highways Authority of India has proposed declaring PNC Infratech a non-performer entity. Toll collection on the Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway has been suspended until repairs are completed. Action has also been initiated against sitting and former project directors for alleged negligence. An IIT Kharagpur team will investigate the cause of the road slippage. The concessionaire will bear the cost of rectifying the damaged stretch.

title: Watch: Indian cargo ship engulfed in flames & smoke after projectile strike off Yemen
content: An Indian-flagged cargo vessel was struck by a projectile in Yemeni waters. The ship caught fire and sank off Yemen’s western coast near Hodeidah. All fourteen crew members, including thirteen Indians, were rescued by the Yemeni Coast Guard. The National Resistance Forces blamed Houthi rebels for the unprovoked attack. India's Ministry of External Affairs condemned the incident and called for unimpeded navigation.

title: Trump's immigration crackdown hits US military families; over 50 spouses, parents detained
content: Dozens of parents and spouses of US service members face detention and deportation. This marks a significant shift from prior bipartisan immigration policies for military families. Many are detained during routine immigration status adjustment appointments. The Department of Homeland Security states military service does not exempt violations of immigration laws. These detentions negatively impact military readiness and family stability.
